title: Pick the BookWise home page layout
question: All three keep your name, colors and Montserrat headings and use your real books. The one you pick sets the layout for every other screen.

options.label: Genre Spotlight
options.lineage: A bookshop's front table, one book at a time
options.thesis: Pick a genre and one book takes over the whole screen.
materials: Giant real covers on a full blue field
Browse and book pages reuse the genre index
options.viewport: Genre index on the left, one huge cover in the middle, its details, price and buy buttons on the right.
options.risk: Shows one book at a time, so a shopper sees fewer titles before scrolling.

options.label: The Reading Chart
options.thesis: The store is a live ranking of what people actually bought.
materials: Huge rank numerals behind stepped covers
Ranks and sold counts carry into browse and admin
options.viewport: A countdown of your five real best sellers, growing from number 5 on the left to number 1 on the right.
options.risk: Your real sold counts are small (the top book has sold 8), so the numbers look modest until sales grow.

options.label: The Shelf Wall
options.lineage: Standing in front of a wall of shelves
options.thesis: No banner at all: the first thing you see is the books.
materials: Blue shelf edges labeled by genre
Wishlist, cart and orders become shelves too
options.viewport: Three full-width shelves of real covers, one genre per shelf, filling the screen under the header.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three, so it depends on the covers and fine detail to feel special.
